seo.title: Your Company — IT courses and coding school
seo.description: Web development, Python and mobile app courses in Tashkent: live groups of up to 14, portfolio projects and internships with partners at IT Park.
seo.answer: Your Company is a coding school at IT Park (2 Mirzo Ulugbek Street, Tashkent). Courses: front-end and back-end development (9 months), Python and data analysis (6 months), Flutter mobile apps (6 months), and coding for teenagers aged 12–16. Groups of up to 14, classes three evenings a week, from 1,200,000 sum a month; the first class is free.

sections.title: Write your first line of code today
sections.subtitle: Live groups, a mentor on every project and an internship with partners. You can start from zero — all you need is a laptop and three evenings a week.

sections.label: About
sections.title: We teach the way teams actually work
sections.text: Your Company opened at IT Park in 2020. Our teachers are working developers: by day they write code at product companies, in the evenings they lead groups. Every module ends with a code-reviewed project, so graduates leave with 4–6 pieces of work on GitHub and experience of team development with real tasks.

sections.label: Courses
sections.title: Pick a track
sections.intro: All courses are live classes in person or online, with homework and code review.

items.title: Front-end developer
items.text: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and TypeScript. You finish with your own online store and landing page in your portfolio.

items.title: Back-end with Node.js
items.text: APIs, PostgreSQL databases, auth and deployment. You finish with a back end for a real app.

items.title: Python and data analysis
items.text: Python, pandas, SQL, visualisation and machine-learning basics on real datasets.

items.title: Mobile apps with Flutter
items.text: One app for both iOS and Android: UI, networking and publishing to the stores.

items.title: Code for teens 12–16
items.text: Python and games in Scratch and Godot. We learn to think like a programmer, not just copy.

items.title: Basics
items.text: Syntax, logic and Git. Your first small programs in week two.

items.title: Projects
items.text: Every module is a finished project, reviewed by a mentor.

items.title: Team
items.text: A final project in a team of 4–5 working through tasks, like at a company.

items.title: Internship
items.text: Top graduates go on a paid internship with partners at IT Park.
